svg.title: BUDLUM LEAF · P02 STACK, MATERIALS AND BEND
svg.text: BUDLUM LEAF · P02 · STACK, MATERIALS AND BEND
Every layer with its budget, its material and its job. The bend is a measured limit, and the limit belongs to the cover and its hard coat.
A · THE TWO SUB-ASSEMBLIES, LAYER BY LAYER
row height is not linear: thin layers are drawn with a minimum height so they stay readable
SCREEN 0.43
BATTERY 2.20

g.text: hard coat · 0.01 · scratch resistance, 0.63% strain at R 25.5 mm
optical clear adhesive · 0.035 · low modulus, neutral-axis tuning
touch, Ag-Cu metal mesh · 0.035 · never brittle ITO
flexible AMOLED + TFE + PI · 0.11 · 144 Hz, 508 ppi
backing polycarbonate + PSA · 0.09 · closes the 0.43 mm screen
graphite-Cu spreader + PTFE slip liner · 0.47 mm per side
silicone slip interlayers · 3 x 0.05 · between the 4 cell layers
outer Al-polymer pouch · 2 x 0.125 · continuous sealed skin
4 continuous polymer-gel cell layers of 0.45 · 1.80 mm active
each layer: own fuse, own temperature strip, own BMS channel
split neutral plane · 0.38% collector strain at R 25.5 mm
bend-rated heat spreader · 0.15 · full-area graphite-Cu (rule H14)
bottom extraction cap · 4.0 mm · flush with r 0.80 mm prism edge
dual-lip FKM gasket · IP68 water seal (1.5 m, 30 min)

svg.text: barrier target: below 10⁻⁶ g/m²/day for the whole
encapsulation, measured after a bend.
The core is one part and it is the middle of the sandwich. The two leaves and the rim form the sleeve.
The layers slide against each other in the band. They are not bonded. Slip allowance: 5 mm per side.
Near the neutral axis of the stack the cells see less strain than their thickness suggests.
Two contact faces break the thermal path to the core. A measured cost, not an opinion (G-H6).
The slide wears the contacts. Compare a contactless inductive or capacitive link (G-H5).
B · MATERIAL REGISTER · one term, one meaning
PART
MATERIAL

g.text: carbon fiber composite, broken at the band
a separate part from the anchor
foil laminate, mesh, graphite, ceramic polymer
the module carries its own magnet set
USB-C receptacle, and a 3.5 mm analog jack
metal allowed: it is not in the bend path (H6)

svg.text: TWO NAMES THAT MUST NOT BE CONFUSED
a. the D-Web Passport in the Budlum gateway is an identity profile with
evidence labels. it is not a hardware part.
b. the hardware record of a core or a module is therefore called a
COMPONENT RECORD in this program, never a passport, so that one
term keeps one meaning across the tree. it is signed by a
secure element in the part, stored as a content-addressed B.U.D. object.
C · TOLERANCE, RESERVE, NEUTRAL AXIS
4.00 mm is a maximum, not a target. Three sub-assemblies with a
tolerance of plus or minus 0.05 each, spread over 0.30 mm. The
design targets 3.90 and holds the maximum at or below 4.00.
THE TRADE LIST, IN ORDER
1 · cover 0.25 to 0.20 mm
2 · magnetic anchor layer 0.05 to 0.03 mm
3 · slip layer 0.03 to 0.02 mm
4 · one cell sheet fewer
5 · seal film 0.05 to 0.03 mm
each trade carries the measured value it costs.
NEUTRAL AXIS
target: the active and transistor layers sit within 10 percent of
the leaf thickness from the leaf neutral axis.
the adhesive is a tool: a thicker low-modulus layer on the
compressive side moves the neutral axis.
creep moves the axis over time and temperature: measure it after
1 000 hours at 60 C, then re-derive the axis.
record the layer tolerance: a tolerance is a design input.
mono check · strain = t / (2 × R)
the formula is the conservative case for a bonded stack. a sliding
stack and a flexible cell both beat it. measure the real limit and
never trust the formula either way.
D · THE DURABILITY BEND · 180 degrees, radius set by strain, and the band is a part with its own rules
inner radius R
R at or above 25 mm: the hard coat reaches 0.50 percent strain
below 12 mm: the hard coat fails before the display does
the band is about 90 mm wide for R = 25 at 180 degrees: a soft U, not a crease.
no component, no rigid board, no magnet, no connector, no stiffener (rule H7).
the band carries: display layers, adhesive, touch mesh, flex circuits, core cells.
TEST SET · screening 1 000 cycles · qualification 10 000 · destruction 100 000, at -20, 0 and 60 C.
ACCEPTANCE · capacity loss below 5 percent · no dead line · touch works · no delamination.
a monitored flex trace below a 10 percent rise · the core still slides · crease below its limit.
STRAIN TABLE · t / (2 × R)
R
cover 0.25
hard coat 0.01
cell sheet 0.38
verdict

g.text: the hard coat is at risk

svg.text: published anchors for the cell line: a flexible lithium-ion cell at more than 20 000 flex cycles and a 10 mm radius, and a textile cell below 1 mm.
the formula does not know about sliding layers. that is why the table sets the test radii and the gate sets the claim.
FORBIDDEN BEFORE THE GATE · "unbreakable when folded" · "foldable phone" · "the device folds in half".
the device bends and it survives the bend. it does not stay folded. the claim is the measured radius.
E · THE GATES OF THIS PLATE

g.text: the complete sandwich in a 180 degree bend, capacity, image, touch, crease, the core still slides
every layer, including each metal part of rule H14, at the class radius
cover, hard coat, edge joint: pencil hardness, steel wool, pen drop, joint step height
the bend flex and the inter-field bridge: a monitored trace below a 10 percent rise
the measured thickness of every layer and of the total, at the maximum tolerance

svg.text: REPORT BL2 · the display stack report: stack, neutral axis, leaves, adhesive, barrier, touch, driver, bend flex, decoder route.
REPORT BL7 · the mechanical report: the materials, the assembly, the bend band, the sleeve, the service, the ingress, the drop, the crease.
REPORT BL8 · the durability report: the bend life, the crease, the flex, the failure modes.
REPORT BL11 · the mass and thickness budget, per configuration.
a gate result without raw data is an opinion. every instrument carries a calibration date in the record.
